items.title: 高蛋白软面包
items.query: 设计一款高蛋白软面包，蛋白质 ≥ 12%，无麸质，保质期 7 天，成本适中
items.expected: 无麸质高蛋白面包组合，含结构胶体和蛋白复配
items.query_en: Design a high-protein soft bread with ≥12% protein, gluten-free, 7-day shelf life and moderate cost
items.expected_en: Gluten-free high-protein bread with structure hydrocolloids and protein blends

items.title: 低糖高蛋白酸奶
items.query: 低糖高蛋白搅拌型酸奶，糖 ≤ 3%，蛋白质 ≥ 8%，清洁标签，冷藏 28 天
items.expected: 乳蛋白/菊粉/果胶稳定体系
items.query_en: Low-sugar, high-protein stirred yogurt with ≤3% sugar, ≥8% protein, clean label and 28-day refrigerated shelf life
items.expected_en: Milk protein/inulin/pectin stabilisation system

items.title: 植物基肉饼

items.expected: 豌豆蛋白+甲基纤维素+油脂体系
items.query_en: Plant-based beef-flavour patty with ≥15% protein, soy-free, 6-month frozen storage and juicy pan-fried texture
items.expected_en: Pea protein + methylcellulose + fat system

items.title: 天然色素软糖
items.query: 天然色素软糖，草莓风味，无合成色素，pH 3.4，保质期 12 个月
items.expected: 花青素/萝卜红替代，需避光与抗氧化
items.query_en: Strawberry-flavoured gummy with natural colours, no synthetic dyes, pH 3.4 and 12-month shelf life
items.expected_en: Anthocyanin/radish colour replacement; light protection and antioxidants required

items.title: 低钠番茄酱
items.query: 低钠番茄酱，钠降低 30%，Brix 28，pH 3.7，货架期 12 个月
items.expected: KCl 部分替代、增稠和防腐 hurdle

items.title: 植物基冰淇淋
items.query: 燕麦基冰淇淋，无乳，脂肪 10%，抗融，冷冻 12 个月，清洁标签
items.expected: 燕麦/植物油/天然稳定剂体系
items.query_en: Oat-based dairy-free ice cream with 10% fat, heat-shock resistance, 12-month frozen storage and clean label
items.expected_en: Oat/vegetable oil/natural stabiliser system

items.title: 酸性藻蓝蛋白饮料
items.query: 藻蓝蛋白蓝色饮料，pH 4.2，72°C 15 秒巴氏，保留率 ≥ 80%
items.expected: 保护剂+温和工艺；酸性下仍可能不达标
items.query_en: Blue phycocyanin beverage at pH 4.2, 72°C for 15 s pasteurisation and retention ≥80%
items.expected_en: Protectants + gentle processing; may still fail under acidic conditions

items.title: 乳清蛋白-槲皮素机制
items.query: 分析乳清蛋白与槲皮素的结合机制，运行对接、短 MD 和 QM
items.expected: Vina 对接 + OpenMM + GROMACS + CP2K 结果
items.query_en: Analyse whey protein–quercetin binding with docking, short MD and QM
items.expected_en: Vina docking + OpenMM + GROMACS + CP2K results

items.title: 高蛋白谷物棒
items.query: 高蛋白谷物棒，蛋白质 ≥ 18%，糖 ≤ 25%，耐 30°C 储运，质构不粘牙
items.expected: 蛋白/纤维/结合剂体系，需控制美拉德与硬化
items.query_en: High-protein cereal bar with ≥18% protein, ≤25% sugar, 30°C transport tolerance and non-sticky texture
items.expected_en: Protein/fibre/binder system; control Maillard browning and hardening

items.title: 高纤挤压膨化零食

items.query_en: High-fibre extruded corn snack with ≥8% dietary fibre, ≤500 mg/100 g sodium, crisp texture and aw ≤0.35

items.title: 低盐发酵泡菜
items.query: 低盐泡菜，盐 ≤ 2.5%，pH 4.2，冷藏 60 天，控制亚硝酸盐和软化

items.query_en: Low-salt kimchi with ≤2.5% salt, pH 4.2, 60-day refrigerated storage, controlling nitrite and softening

items.title: 可食性保鲜膜

items.title: 益生菌固体饮料
items.query: 益生菌固体饮料，活菌 ≥ 10^8 CFU/g，低糖，冲调后 pH 4.5，货架期 12 个月
items.expected: 冻干/包埋/水分活度控制，需验证活菌和冲调稳定性

items.title: 低糖高纤果冻

items.title: 超高温灭菌乳

items.title: 低脂蛋黄酱
items.query: 低脂蛋黄酱，脂肪 ≤ 30%，pH 3.8，乳化稳定，冷藏 90 天

items.title: 减糖黑巧克力
